name: Concept and Design
summary: Setting the targets the whole car is built around. Chassis & suspension fix the layout and geometry, powertrain settles the engine package, aero and brakes & dynamics size their systems, and electrical plans the wiring and sensors. Finance starts the cost report, business writes the plan we pitch at Silverstone, and sponsorship begins bringing our first partners on board.

name: Manufacturing
summary: Drawings become parts. Manufacturing & fabrication build the chassis and machine components, powertrain prepares the engine and cooling, aero builds the bodywork and electrical makes the wiring loom. Finance tracks every part against the cost report, business shapes the pitch that sells the car to the judges, and social media documents it taking shape.

name: Build and Test
summary: First assembly, then shakedown. Electrical wires up the car and gets data logging running, brakes & dynamics lead the brake and steering checks, powertrain gets the engine running reliably, and every system is tested to find what fails before a scrutineer does. Business rehearses the plan for the judges.

name: Compete
summary: Silverstone. Scrutineering first, then the static events, where business presents the plan and the engineers defend the design. Then acceleration, skid pad, sprint and endurance, with social media capturing every minute of it.
